items.title: UNI calls for strong workers’ rights in planned GLS–DPD joint venture in Germany
items.summary: UNI Global Union is calling on GLS Group and Geopost to put workers’ rights, collective bargaining and social dialogue at the centre of their planned joint venture in Germany. Creating a new major player in parcel delivery must lead to better jobs, not social dumping. items.title: US Department of Labor proposes to update fiduciary rule to affirm Employee Retirement Income Security Act’s exclusive purpose rule
items.summary: WASHINGTON – The U.S. Department of Labor’s Employee Benefits Security Administration today issued proposed amendments to the investment duties regulation to clarify the fiduciary duty of loyalty under the Employee Retirement Income Security Act.The proposed rule seeks to end the 32-year uncertainty surrounding whether ERISA allows fiduciaries to consider non-financial factors in retirement plan investments, including environmental, social, and governance, and diversity, equity, and inclusion.
